title: 第7章 打击报复第8章 劳动最光荣
lines: 吴厚愣神半晌，才想明白小红的意思。
太监哪有双修的资格。
“我……不是那个意思……”
小红低下头，不敢听也不敢想，不过说到功法，她心中一动。
自己倒是有个地阶修炼功法，虽比不上仙天品质，但比无根功这种人阶功法，不知要强多少。
只不过这是家传功法，密不外授，更是自己隐藏多年的秘密，把它交给吴谦，也不知祖宗会不会怪罪。
小红心中有一丝犹豫。
看着吴厚满脸愁容，手里的包子都快捏露馅。
小红终是心中不忍。
银牙一咬，草草做出决定。
祖宗都死完了，吴谦起码还活着，祖宗怪罪就怪罪好了，不能因为死人再害一个人！
小红一只玉手探入怀中，稍经摸索，便拿出一枚玉简，将其塞给吴谦。
“千万别让其他人知道，否则会再添杀身之祸。”
说完，小红便头也不回的离开。
吴谦回过神时，小红早已钻出房门走远。
“这是什么东西？”
拿起玉简，入手微凉。
“定情信物么？”
吴谦仔细打量，只见上面密密麻麻雕满极小的小篆，小到肉眼根本无法看清。
吴谦眯眼趴上去，玉简突然化作一道白气，从印堂钻入吴谦体内。
第一次见识传功，吴谦喘着粗气，忍不住沉吟道，
“舒服！”
【检测到新的功法：黄庭万华经（地阶珍品）】
【对水系术法修炼加成、伤害加成。
原来小红传给自己一套功法，还是地阶珍品。
不愧是皇宫，随便一个宫女，都能拿出好东西！
功法术法分为：
极、珍、良、凡、废五品，
神、仙、天、地、人五阶，
黄庭万华经是地阶功法，足以修炼到金丹境，对现在的自己来说，确实是好功法。
小红说恐添杀身之祸，那肯定又是见不得光的东西。
吴谦颇为无奈，危机尚未解决，又多个烫手山芋。
望着小红离开的方向，
“可现在缺的不是上限，缺的是经验啊！”
吴谦叹口气，又耽误半天天，眼看已过午时，还停留在一阶炼精期。
“不能再浪费时间，闭门造车对系统没用，必须得走出去寻找机会！”
另一边，范岱也没闲着，从吴厚住处离开后，便趁无人注意，回尚膳监回报消息。
回到尚膳监，范岱畅通无阻，路上所见之人，皆都垂手而立，恭敬行礼。
范岱全当没看见，一路目中无人走进正内。
看门太监早已将信传进去。
首领得信后，安坐太师椅静候。
首领是个三百斤的大胖子，肤色黝黑，满脸横肉，
content_en:
Wu Hou was stunned for a long time before he figured out what Xiao Hong meant.
How can a eunuch be qualified to practice dual cultivation?
"I... didn't mean that..."
Xiaohong lowered her head, not daring to listen or think, but when she mentioned the technique, something moved in her heart.
I do have an earth-level cultivation technique. Although it is not as good as the quality of immortals, it is much better than human-level techniques such as Wugen Gong.
It's just that this is a family-inherited skill that is not taught to outsiders. It is a secret that I have hidden for many years. I don't know if my ancestors will blame me if I hand it over to Wu Qian.
There was a trace of hesitation in Xiaohong's heart.
Seeing Wu Hou's face full of sadness, the bun in his hand was about to reveal its filling.
Xiaohong finally couldn't bear it.
Silver teeth bit it and made a hasty decision.
The ancestors are all dead, but at least Wu Qian is still alive. Just blame the ancestors for the blame. You can't harm another person because of the dead!
Xiaohong put a jade hand into her arms, fumbled for a while, then took out a jade slip and gave it to Wu Qian.
"Don't let others know, otherwise you will be killed again."
After saying that, Xiaohong left without looking back.
When Wu Qian came to his senses, Xiaohong had already walked out of the room and walked away.
"What is this?"
Picking up the jade slip, it was slightly cold in my hands.
"A token of love?"
Wu Qian looked carefully and saw that it was densely carved with extremely small seal characters, so small that they could not be seen clearly with the naked eye.
Wu Qian squinted his eyes and lay down. The jade slip suddenly turned into a stream of white gas and penetrated into Wu Qian's body from the Yintang.
"Ah~ah~"
Seeing Chuan Gong for the first time, Wu Qian breathed heavily and couldn't help but muttered,
"Comfortable!"
[New skill detected: Huangting Ten Thousand Flowers Sutra (Treasure of Earth Level)]
[Bonus to water spell practice and damage bonus.
It turns out that Xiaohong passed on a set of skills to him, which are still earth-level treasures.
It is indeed a palace, any maid can come up with good things!
Kung Fu spells are divided into:
The five grades are extremely, rare, good, ordinary and useless.
The five levels of gods, immortals, heaven, earth, and humans are
The Huangting Ten Thousand Flowers Sutra is an earth-level technique that is enough to cultivate to the Golden Core Realm. It is indeed a good technique for me now.
Xiao Hong said that it might cause death, but it must be something shady.
Wu Qian is quite helpless. The crisis has not been resolved yet, and there are many hot potatoes.
Looking at the direction Xiaohong left,
"But what's lacking now is not the upper limit, what's lacking is experience!"
Wu Qian sighed and delayed for another long time. Seeing that it was past noon, he was still in the first-level refining stage.
"We can't waste any more time. Working behind closed doors is of no use to the system. We must go out and look for opportunities!"
——————
On the other side, Fan Dai was not idle either. After leaving Wu Hou's residence, he returned to Shangshan Supervisor to report the news while no one was paying attention.
When he returned to Shangshan Prison, Fan Dai was able to pass unobstructed. Everyone he saw on the road stood with their hands down and saluted respectfully.
Fan Dai pretended not to see it and walked into the main hall in a defiant manner.
The eunuch at the gate had already passed the letter in.
After the leader received the letter, he sat quietly in the Taishi chair and waited.
The leader is a fat man weighing three hundred pounds, with a dark complexion and a face full of flesh.
